    {"key": "k_144", "description": "Encoded dimension k = 2N - 2 rank_F2(H) of the Gross BB code with l=12, m=6, a=x^3+y+y^2, b=y^3+x+x^2 (N=72), with H defined as for k_72.", "units": "dimensionless"},
    {"key": "k_288", "description": "Encoded dimension k = 2N - 2 rank_F2(H) of the BB code with l=12, m=12, a=x^3+y^2+y^7, b=y^3+x+x^2 (N=144), with H defined as for k_72.", "units": "dimensionless"},
    {"key": "r_M_72", "description": "Metacheck rank r_M = dim_F2 ker(H^T) = N - rank_F2(H) for the [[72,12,6]] code (l=6, m=6, a=x^3+y+y^2, b=y^3+x+x^2), H=[L_{b*}|L_{a*}] as in k_72.", "units": "dimensionless"},
